text:
Deepa: Quick proposal — shrink the three-mode facade to a minimal handshake + capability discovery. Keep control-plane only for negotiation and metadata, push adapter-specific translation to adapters. This should reduce control-plane surface area and avoid coupling private hosted quirks into runtime.

Laura: Strong +1 on reducing surface area. But we can't hide auth/KMS flows — private deployments need explicit KMS/HSM wiring. How does that get expressed in a minimal handshake?

Mike: From runtime side, pushing translation out means adapters need to validate batch sizing and KV cache expectations. We currently rely on control-plane checks to early-reject bad manifests. Are we okay duplicating some validation?

Tzach: What if handshake is small: tenant + adapter-id + capability matrix. Adapters advertise supported capabilities and versions. Control-plane negotiates and returns an "adapter_profile" blob the runtime can cache. Example idea format: 

```
capabilities:
  - name: prefix-kv-cache
    versions: ["1.0"]
  - name: kms-integrations
    optional: true
```

Laura: That reads well. Private can advertise kms-integrations:true and hosted will not. Need a robust versioning & negotiation fallback (e.g., operator can mark capability as required).

Mike: Tradeoffs: initial call needs extra metadata + negotiation step, small latency hit. But runtime can cache adapter_profile per-tenant, so steady-state unaffected. Also avoids control-plane having to implement every adapter shim.

Deepa: Ops requirements: we must standardize trace headers and include per-request capability vector so fallback behavior shows up in traces/metrics. Also ensure audit logs capture when a capability negotiation fell back to a safe default.

deploy-bot: New RFC created: rfc/three-mode-facade-slim-v1 — https://rfc.internal/r/three-mode-facade-slim-v1 :tada:

Laura: Next steps: @Mike to prototype capability discovery handshake, @Laura to write KMS/KV requirement doc, @Deepa to own the RFC writeup + rollout plan.

Mike: I'll drop a PoC branch today with a tiny handshake and a cached adapter_profile.

Deepa: Thanks all — goal is to keep the surface explicit and avoid implicit translations in the control plane. If we can make the negotiation cheap and cacheable this simplifies adapters and reduces duplication. :+1:
